protocol.order: Primary: warmup baseline then candidate, then measured pairs with order alternating by round. Confirmation and supplementary captures: no warmup, alternating order. All processes passed smoke and sequence/burst validation.
protocol.confirmation_reason: The primary seven-pair spread exceeded 25%; three fresh confirmation pairs were run as required by the protocol. The supplementary three pairs were added after the confirmation pairs showed a different sign from the primary capture; they are reported separately and included only in the 13-pair combined table.
protocol.typing_cadence: Typing starts 500 ms after start once the fixture document's bounded source window is ready. Each character advances only after the previous character's description was built, with a 30 ms floor; setup and post-burst builds are attributed separately.
protocol.smoke_window: Reference host fixed 3 s smoke window. Every primary, confirmation, supplementary, and typing process completed inside it.
protocol.metric_note: Per-step build_ns is the application describe callback only. application_build_ns is the host's whole application build callback, which also contains begin_frame/end_frame (runtime reconcile, layout, paint). Phase-2 runtime savings therefore appear in application_build_ns, not in per-step build_ns.
protocol.reuse_note: The nine-action sequence, fixture, cadence, metrics, warmup/confirmation structure, and run_windows_ab.ps1 are reused from the previous 2026-11-21 capture. The bounded typing burst and the three supplementary pairs are the only protocol additions.

deviations: The requested baseline 0beff9d cannot build the current Scratchpad frontend; 68d3aff (the last pre-#227 revision with the hosted WebGPU host) was used, exactly as in the previous capture.
The build is a release build (--release) to match the 2026-11-04 profile and the release frame-budget question; the recipe in the task omitted it.
The reference SDL_GPU host was measured, not the hosted WebGPU renderer: only the reference host publishes application_build_ns, first_application_submit_ns, and primary_gpu_submissions.
The first command step waits 500 ms and later steps advance on the previous description instead of a fixed 150 ms cadence, identical to the previous capture.

Three supplementary nine-pair captures were run after the 7+3 capture because the confirmation segment disagreed with the primary segment in sign; they are reported as a separate segment and in the 13-pair combined table.

The typing burst is a new bounded extra scenario. Its two arms use different diagnostic hook variants only because the baseline revision has no phase-2 counter fields; the extra fields are printed at step boundaries and are not read by the A/B binaries.

The diagnostics builds used for counter extraction differ from the A/B builds only by the env-gated counter-print block. The printed counters are cumulative Frame_Stats deltas and do not change the measured work.

instrumentation.hook_print: alicorn-performance-sequence-step step=N action_ns=... build_ns=... builds=N; alicorn-performance-sequence steps=9 complete=true passed=true build_ns=...; typing equivalent under alicorn-performance-typing-step / alicorn-performance-typing.
instrumentation.counters: Diagnostic variants print cumulative Frame_Stats deltas per step. The candidate variant additionally prints descriptions_retained_match, structure_sequence_matches, splice, sparse-layout, and stage timings. The committed A/B binaries do not print or use counters.
instrumentation.counter_note: Integer work counters do not depend on optimization level. The matched sequence diagnostic capture covers three pairs per arm; the typing A/B binaries carry the same env-gated counter print, so all ten typing pairs provide per-character counters.

stalls.note: Two of thirteen candidate sequence processes recorded a single 32 ms / 76 ms build in the close-Quick-Open step; the baseline sequence arm recorded none. A separate diagnostic run captured a 15.5 ms stall whose stage_description_ns was 16.9 ms while stage_reconcile_ns was 1.3 ms, and one baseline typing process stalled for 104 ms. The stalls are application/host-side tail events, not phase-2 reconcile work, and they inflate the candidate p95 in this capture.
